concept.title: The problem
concept.shortdesc: About 18,900 listings from eight directories were examined, and four difficulties stood in the way of finding services across them.

conbody.p: The work starts from about 18,900 listings in the eight directories that could be reached in November 2026:

ul.li: Open Sessions, a national feed of sport and activity sessions

conbody.p: Looking closely at them showed four difficulties. Together they led to one conclusion: services need to be classified by what their descriptions mean, and the categories should come from the services that really exist.
